description: This Kotlin source file defines a BackupService class for handling backup and restore operations of notes in an Android app, including notification management and coroutine-based background tasks.

classes.name: BackupService
classes.description: An Android LifecycleService that manages background backup and restore of notes, including notification updates and coroutine jobs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification manager when the service is created.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to trigger backup or restore operations based on the action specified.

methods.name: onTimeout
methods.description: Cancels ongoing jobs and stops the service if a timeout occurs.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels the lifecycle scope when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: startJob
methods.description: Launches a coroutine job for background processing and manages its completion.

methods.name: backupNotes
methods.description: Performs backup of notes to a specified URI, showing progress via notifications.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Restores notes from a backup URI, with notification updates for progress and completion.
